rationale: X reaches the correct review verdict and accurately covers the strict contract, exception mapping and full message, non-mutation of the collection, non-strict append-and-return behavior, and custom exception classes. The implementation establishes all of this at activemodel/lib/active_model/errors.rb:321-352, while errors_test.rb:227-234 and validations_test.rb:396-447 cover the normal return and strict class/message behavior; focused verification passed with 7 runs and 11 assertions across those tests, and a direct probe confirmed both strict forms leave the collection empty. X is more verbose and its own runtime probe was not completed successfully, but its final claims are source-backed and materially at parity with the references.
shortcomings: X.thread.md's ad hoc runtime probe raised an unintended `NoMethodError` (`undefined method 'remove' for an instance of String`) instead of either strict exception; after saying it would rerun against real test models, the thread only read those models and finalized. R1.thread.md completed the equivalent probe successfully, so X's executed verification was weaker even though its source and test inspection still settled the answer.
